text:
**Short answer:** none of the results describes a single station that natively handles a laptop, a phone, and a watch. The closest is the Baseus Nomos, and otherwise a two-piece setup works best.

## Closest all-in-one: Baseus Nomos 5-in-1 (140W + Qi2), $149.99
- One 140W USB-C port can charge a 16" MacBook Pro. It also has a retractable 100W cable, a second USB-C port, a USB-A port, and a 15W Qi2 magnetic pad for the phone.
- It has no watch puck. You'd charge the watch from a spare USB-C or USB-A port with its own cable (my inference from the port list).
- Only one port reaches 140W. The retractable cable and the second USB-C port top out at 100W, and USB-A at 15W.
- It was **sold out** on Baseus's US store when checked on 2026-10-21, so check stock before ordering.
- [Buy at Baseus](https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-nomos-5-in-1-140w-qi2). This is an affiliate link, so the site earns a commission at no cost to you. Source: [Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/baseus-nomos-5-in-1-140w-qi2).

## Two-piece setup (best if you use Apple devices)
**Phone and watch (and AirPods), Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand, about $98**
- WIRED's pick for best overall. It charges an iPhone at up to 15W, fast-charges an Apple Watch Series 7 or newer, and has a base pad for AirPods.
- WIRED lists it at $98, with $90 at Amazon and $80 at Best Buy.
- Buy via [WIRED's guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/), which links to the retailers.
- A cheaper Qi2 option from the same guide is the ESR Qi2 3-in-1, about $40, with a 33W adapter included.

**Laptop, pick one:**
- **Anker 341 USB-C Hub (7-in-1), about $40.** It passes through up to 100W to a laptop and adds HDMI and card slots. Per [StandDeskLab](https://standdesklab.com/accessories/best-desk-charging-station/), the 100W passthrough charges the laptop while the hub is in use. That implies you still supply your own laptop charger, though the source doesn't say so outright.
- **Belkin Connect USB-C 11-in-1 Pro GaN Dock, about $138 (list $200).** It delivers 96W and supports up to three 4K displays. It's a better fit if you also want monitors. See [WIRED's dock guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-laptop-docking-stations/).

## Things to check
- **Laptop wattage:** a MacBook Air needs about 30–35W, a 14" MacBook Pro about 70W, and a 16" about 140W ([The Office Journal](https://www.theofficejournal.com/guide/best-charging-stations-for-multiple-devices-desk)). Make sure the charger covers yours.
- **Android phone or non-Apple watch:** the 3-in-1 stands above are built for Apple devices, so the Baseus Nomos plus a separate watch cable is the better route.
- **Prices vary by source:** the Anker 3-in-1 stand is listed anywhere from about $35 to $90 across the guides, so check the current price.

If you tell me your laptop model and whether you use an iPhone/Apple Watch, I can narrow this to one pick.
